title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Wanted
desc: A sharpshooter is caught between a gangster who wants him dead since he knows too much, the police who want him for the information he holds and his girlfriend who yearns for him to mend his ways.

title: Naagmati
desc: Deadly snake legends haunt a crumbling palace, claiming lives mysteriously. Officer Boominathan steps in to investigate. What dark secrets will he uncover?

title: Policegiri
desc: Tired of the rampant corruption fueled by Nagori Subramaniam, DCP Rudra takes a defiant stand. He launches a one-man crusade to take down the crime lord and dismantle his criminal syndicate.

title: Apaharan
desc: Ajay, an aspiring policeman, borrows money from a moneylender to pursue his dream. However, he is unable to repay the loan on time and decides to be a part of a kidnapping scheme.

title: International Khiladi
desc: An international crime boss and his journalist girlfriend fall victim to an elaborate conspiracy that claims an innocent life and turns them into bitter enemies.
